Deployment.description: Configures the deployment of packages. The values can also be defined per tenant under 'OrchardCore:{TenantName}:Deployment'. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Deployment/.

Package.description: The limits applied to a deployment package when it's imported. All the limits must be positive.

MaxUploadBytes.description: The maximum size of a package, in bytes.

MaxExpandedBytes.description: The maximum total size of the files of a package once expanded, in bytes.

MaxEntries.description: The maximum number of entries of a package.

Artifacts.description: The limits applied to the private deployment artifacts of the management API. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Deployment/#private-artifact-storage.

MaxBytes.description: The maximum size of an artifact, in bytes.

Lifetime.description: How long an artifact is kept, in the 'd.hh:mm:ss' format.

Operations.description: The queued deployment operations of the management API. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Deployment/#queued-deployment-operations.

Retention.description: How long an operation stays available after it ended, in the 'd.hh:mm:ss' format. Its request ID can be used again afterwards. A value of zero keeps operations forever.
